steps.text: It's summer! Nina wants a beach day at Willow Pond. Find something to float on and something to dig with.
checklist: Prue's old swim ring, by the Blastoffs' door
A bucket and spade from Nuts & Bolts Hardware

steps.text: Build a sandcastle with Nina on the little beach at Willow Pond, by the dock.
Run to the end of the dock and do a cannonball into Willow Pond!
Cool off with a pink lemonade at the Hollow Diner. Ask Gus!

reward.message: Summer Splash: a sandcastle, a cannonball and pink lemonade with Nina. Best beach day ever! (+12 sparkles)
